tasks.title: Protected pages use the shell, busy-button script and single-use form tokens
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, Behavior: ConsoleServerDeps, protected-route types/dispatcher, Overview root integration, script route and metrics; Decisions 6 and 8-11; Required behavior 1, 3 and state fixtures of 6; Checks 4-5, 7, 7a, 7b and 9. Keep the form-token store and its synchronous enforcement in this single task. Implement the 32-byte base64url token, sessionDigest/raw-action-path binding, 43200000 ms lifetime, 100 unused tokens per session and 10000 total entries, with injected now/randomBytes and no table/timer. ProtectedRoute has renderForm for invalid-token redisplay; HEAD issues no stored token. Enforce method/phase/Host/session/POST parsing and CSRF/role/token/handler in the specified order, logging token refusal without its value. A replay is 409 Already submitted with no action; invalid tokens redisplay safe input with a fresh token and the exact expired notice; all error redisplays renew tokens. Register real shared-state fixtures only through validated /__test/ deps outside src; T4 extends them with confirmations and the confirmation-specific cross-path token test. Replace landingPage with the live Overview, add signed-in shell 404 and safe expiry return paths, wire instanceName everywhere, preserve existing assertions and only add instanceName to server.setup.test.ts. Serve CONSOLE_JS at GET/HEAD /console.js with its path label; only the shell loads it. Implement the Decision 6 document submit handler, deferred disabling after form-data construction, duplicate-submit suppression and persisted pageshow reset, with no other script behavior. Preserve setup/sign-in/sign-out, cookies, CSP, CSRF and raw-path semantics. Respect #563 fully-signed-in and #564 stored-role integration if those land first, without redoing them.
